name: Stepper
summary: Show where a short linear flow is — finished, current and upcoming stages — as one framework-free element that also works on a slide canvas and an audience phone.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-stepper> — defined once, imported unchanged by HTML, React and Vue. It is the LEAF counterpart to the composite Steps (antd): no React needed, so a build-less slide type (presenter.html / audience.html loading lib/all.js) gets the same stepper instead of hand-rolling pills. The current stage is marked with INK — a solid ink outline on the marker plus a semibold label — never the primary accent, so on a canvas the accent stays on the one button that advances the flow. Every colour derives from currentColor, so setting `color` on the element (the deck ink on a canvas) re-inks the whole stepper on light, dark and photo decks. A `current` change toggles attributes on persistent nodes, so the marker, label and connector transitions fire.

spec.label: Marker
spec.value: 24px circle (lg 32px), 1.5px border, step number; finished swaps the number for system-check

spec.label: Current
spec.value: ink outline (currentColor) + 8% ink tint + semibold label · aria-current="step" · never the primary accent

spec.label: Finished
spec.value: 60% ink border + check, 80% ink label, 60% ink connector

spec.label: Upcoming
spec.value: 35% ink border, 62% ink number and label, 20% ink connector

spec.label: Label
spec.value: 14px (lg 18px, the canvas body size); under 480px of width only the current stage's label stays visible (the rest stay screen-reader text)

spec.label: Ink
spec.value: currentColor, default --aha-text-default #1A1A1A; set color on the element to follow the deck ink

props.name: steps
props.desc: The ordered stages — a pipe list, a JSON attribute, or a `.steps` property

props.name: current
props.desc: Zero-based index of the current stage; earlier stages show as finished

props.name: size
props.desc: lg = 32px marker + 18px label, for a slide canvas read from across the room

props.name: navigable
props.desc: Each stage becomes a button; a click sets `current` and emits `change`

props.name: completed-label
props.desc: Screen-reader suffix for finished stages — pass the translated word

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the list — pass a translated name

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event when a navigable stage is clicked

whenToUse.when: a short linear flow (2–6 stages) on any surface, including a slide canvas or audience phone with no React — e.g. a retro's Ideas → Group → Vote → Discuss
a React / Vue app wizard that needs vertical layout, descriptions, dot style or per-step error status
peer views the user switches between freely — no order, no progress

opinion.note: Keep labels to one or two words. The stepper shows progress; it is not the control that advances it — pair it with one primary <aha-button> (Next), which keeps the accent. Never recolour the current stage with the accent or a semantic colour, and never restyle it through ::part.
opinion.dsv3: NEW leaf — the framework-free twin of the DS V3 Steps set. Numbered 24/32px markers, check on finished, ink-marked current stage (canvas judge C16/C23: a stepper never takes the primary accent), 1px hairline connectors, motion tokens on persistent nodes.

a11y.role: an ordered list (<ol>) with an accessible name; the current item carries aria-current="step"; finished items add a visually hidden "Completed" suffix
a11y.keyboard: static by default (nothing to focus). With `navigable`, each stage is a native <button> in tab order — Enter / Space activates; no roving role is declared
a11y.note: Markers are aria-hidden; the label text is the accessible name of each stage, so the step number is not read twice.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render in every framework. React < 19 sets `steps` as a property through a ref; Vue binds `:steps.prop`.

selfCheck.label: current stage marked with ink outline + semibold, never the accent
aria-current="step" re-synced on every current change (observed)
current change animates on persistent nodes

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The probe stepper sits on a white stage at current=1 with the default ink.
